research_gaps: Limited real‑time performance of high‑capacity Vision‑Transformer (ViT) backbones on edge hardware, hindering deployment in robotics and AR/VR.
Insufficient handling of extreme domain shifts (e.g., night, rain, fog) despite recent domain‑generalization tricks; current methods still drop >15% accuracy under severe conditions.
Lack of end‑to‑end frameworks that simultaneously exploit depth, pose, semantics, and neural‑rendering refinements, leading to fragmented pipelines and sub‑optimal joint optimization.

proposals.name: Hybrid Lightweight Conv‑ViT with Dynamic Token Sparsification (LCT‑Depth)
proposals.rationale: Combine a shallow CNN encoder for low‑level features with a token‑sparse ViT that adaptively prunes tokens based on attention entropy, preserving global context while reducing FLOPs.
proposals.expected_benefit: Achieves <30 ms inference on a Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 GPU with <5% relative drop vs. full‑size ViT on standard benchmarks; enables on‑device deployment.
proposals.risk: Token pruning may discard informative regions in texture‑less areas, requiring careful calibration and possibly a fallback refinement stage.

proposals.name: Self‑Supervised Adversarial Domain Mixer (SS‑ADM) for Extreme Weather
proposals.rationale: Introduce a domain‑mixing adversarial module that synthesizes hard weather/illumination augmentations on‑the‑fly and enforces consistency via a dual‑branch photometric loss and a weather‑invariant pose predictor.
proposals.expected_benefit: Reduces the performance gap under unseen adverse conditions by up to 12% absolute RMSE on the DrivingDepth benchmark, without needing extra labeled data.
proposals.risk: Adversarial training can destabilize convergence; synthetic weather may not capture all real‑world sensor artefacts, leading to over‑regularization.

proposals.name: Joint Depth‑Pose‑Semantic‑NeRF (JDP‑NeRF) Unified Trainer
proposals.rationale: Build a single differentiable graph that outputs depth, ego‑motion, semantic segmentation masks, and a lightweight NeRF decoder; losses are coupled via shared encoder features and a consistency term between predicted depth and NeRF geometry.
proposals.expected_benefit: Produces sub‑pixel depth accuracy (~30% sharper edges) while simultaneously delivering semantic maps and novel‑view synthesis, reducing pipeline complexity and inference latency compared to sequential models.
proposals.risk: Training becomes memory‑intensive and may require multi‑GPU setups; joint optimization may converge to sub‑optimal equilibria if loss weighting is not carefully balanced.

recommended_option: Hybrid Lightweight Conv‑ViT with Dynamic Token Sparsification (LCT‑Depth)
